basics.name: Jackson Small
basics.summary: Data Science student at UCF Burnett Honors College (GPA 3.83). Admitted UCF M.S. Statistics and Data Science (Fall 2026) with Graduate Teaching Assistantship. First Data Science undergraduate to publish in UCF STARS Honors Undergraduate Thesis repository.

work.summary: Sole engineer across six production workstreams on a .NET/SQL enterprise claims platform — AI agent orchestration, big data migrations, HIPAA compliance infrastructure, static analysis tooling, SDK integrations.
highlights: Directed AI coding agents (Claude, Replit) as sole engineer across six production workstreams, delivering 37,600+ net lines of C#, SQL, and Python over 11 months with full architectural ownership and review of all generated output

Migrated 175 enterprise reports to Power BI across 6 business lines in 3 weeks ($700,000 cost avoidance, 17x industry speed, 264,000+ lines XML, 1,225 modifications, 187 DB connections, 100% pass rate, zero production incidents)
Architected dual-layer HIPAA audit system for 23 PHI tables (9,594 lines C#/SQL), 85-96% storage reduction (1,745 to 186 bytes), 5-step username resolution chain, 3-tier RBAC, field masking
Built a Roslyn static analysis tool producing a type-resolved inventory of every data-layer call site, then a Python codemod that automated the refactor from that inventory

Delivered enterprise document-storage integration in 22 days vs. 3-6 month industry standard (provider-pattern architecture, OAuth2 lifecycle management, DualWrite zero-downtime migration, 234 automated tests across 16 REST route families)

work.summary: Human systems research — VR/AR simulations and behavioral data analysis.
highlights: Built automated data validation pipelines in Python and SQL for large human-systems research datasets
Led QA on VR/AR Unity simulations; validated eye-tracking software for participant gaze capture
Conducted statistical analysis on behavioral data across experimental conditions; led pilot studies (~300 participants)

publications.name: Theoretical Analysis of CNNs for Automatic Seizure Detection in EEG Signals
publications.summary: First Data Science undergraduate to publish in the UCF STARS Honors Undergraduate Thesis repository. Built 1D CNN with Butterworth filtering pipeline achieving 97% accuracy and 0.99 AUC on EEG seizure detection. Formally proved Lipschitz stability bounds (L = 24.72). Advised by Dr. Chudamani Poudyal (SDMSS, UCF).
